books.whyReadJa: 「女性として生きる」ことをこれほど等身大に描いた小説は稀。韓国社会を通して、普遍的なジェンダー問題に気づかされる。
books.selectionReasonJa: 韓国社会現象を巻き起こし、世界35か国以上で翻訳された、現代フェミニズム文学の代表作。
books.descriptionEn: Kim Jiyoung, born in Seoul in 1982, the second daughter of a family that wanted a boy. The novel follows her ordinary life in flat, almost clinical prose: her childhood, her schooling, her jobs, her marriage, her daughter, her slowly accumulating exhaustion and rage—the everyday, unremarkable inequalities that shape a woman's life in Korean society. When she begins to speak in the voices of other women, her family seeks help. A novel written with deliberate flatness that became a global publishing phenomenon and a catalyst for a nationwide conversation about gender.
books.whyReadEn: Rare is the novel that depicts living as a woman so true to life, so recognizable, and so quietly devastating. Through one ordinary Korean woman, it makes universal gender questions visible—questions that Japanese readers will recognize immediately. A short, essential, deeply humane book.

books.title: Aşk
books.author: Elif Shafak
books.descriptionJa: 13世紀の神秘主義詩人ルーミーと、師シャムス・タブリーズィー。現代の主婦エラの人生とが交錯する、愛と神秘主義の物語。トルコを代表する作家シャファクの、最も愛された作品。
books.whyReadJa: イスラム神秘主義（スーフィズム）を、現代と中世の二重構造で描く。トルコ文学の国際的な顔。
books.selectionReasonJa: トルコを代表する作家シャファクの代表作。イスラム文化と現代を架橋する傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Thirteenth-century Konya: Rumi, the great mystic poet, is a respected scholar and preacher whose orderly life is overturned when he meets Shams of Tabriz, a wandering dervish who becomes his beloved teacher and unleashes a spiritual revolution. In the present day, Ella, an American housewife unhappily stuck in a comfortable marriage, reads a novel about them as part of her work as a manuscript reader, and her own life begins to transform. A novel about love, mysticism, and the risk of following your heart, told in a double structure across the two centuries, by Turkey's most internationally beloved novelist.
books.whyReadEn: Islamic mysticism—Sufism—rendered through a brilliant dual structure that joins the medieval and the modern, the ecstatic and the domestic. Shafak is the international face of Turkish literature, and this is her most beloved and most life-changing book. Reading it is an experience.

books.title: Exit West
books.author: Mohsin Hamid
books.descriptionJa: 戦火の中、二人の若者ナディアとサイードは、突然現れる「扉」を通って別の都市へ移動する。難民の移動をSF的な仕掛けで描き、ブッカー賞最終候補となった、現代の寓話。
books.whyReadJa: 難民問題を文学として最も新しく描いた作品。ドア越しに別の世界へ——移民の本質を捉える傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: ブッカー賞最終候補。難民をめぐる現代の寓話として、世界中で読まれた。
books.descriptionEn: Somewhere in a city falling apart under civil war, two young people, Nadia and Saeed, fall in love. Then the doors appear: magical doors that open onto other cities—Mykonos, London, Marin, other worlds—and the pair join the vast migration of people passing through them in search of safety. A love story, a refugee story, and an allegory of the movement of peoples in our century, told with Hamid's characteristic spare brilliance. A Booker Prize finalist, it renders the essence of migration with an invention no one else has attempted.
books.whyReadEn: The newest and most inventive literary treatment of the refugee crisis—a love story in which the door to another world stands in for borders, boats, and the terrifying act of leaving everything behind. A short, beautiful, essential novel about what it means to have to start over.

books.title: A Fine Balance
books.author: Rohinton Mistry
books.authorJa: ロヒントン・ミストリー
books.descriptionJa: 1975年、非常事態宣言下のインド。寡婦ドリと、仕立て屋の二人の兄弟、青年マネク。カーストと暴力の時代に、四つの人生が交錯する。インドの近現代史を描く、ブッカー賞最終候補の大河。
books.whyReadJa: インドの「非常事態」を、庶民の目線から描いた傑作。現代インド文学の最高到達点の一つ。
books.selectionReasonJa: インド文学の最高傑作の一つ。ブッカー賞最終候補として国際的な評価を確立した。
books.descriptionEn: India, 1975. Prime Minister Indira Gandhi has declared a state of emergency, and the poor are being swept off the streets into forced sterilization camps. In a single flat in Bombay, four lives are thrown together: Dina, a widowed seamstress struggling to keep her independence; Ishvar and Om, two tailor brothers driven from their village by caste violence; and Maneck, a young student who has left his family's Himalayan shop to study in the city. Their story, told across years of friendship and betrayal, is a sweeping, heartbreaking, deeply humane portrait of India in one of its darkest hours.
books.whyReadEn: A masterpiece that depicts India's Emergency from the viewpoint of ordinary people, with all the warmth and horror that implies. One of the highest achievements of contemporary fiction in any language, it makes the reader love its four characters and grieve with them as history crushes their hopes.

books.title: Siete casas vacías
books.author: Samanta Schweblin
books.authorJa: サマンタ・シュウェブリン
books.descriptionJa: 七つの家をめぐる、七つの不安な物語。母と娘、夫婦、隣人——日常の裏側に潜む恐ろしさを、鋭い感覚で描く短編集。国際ブッカー賞最終候補。ラテンアメリカ文学の新しい旗手。
books.whyReadJa: 「日常の不気味さ」をこれほど研ぎ澄ました短編は稀。ラテンアメリカ文学の新しい世代を代表する。
books.selectionReasonJa: 国際ブッカー賞最終候補。ラテンアメリカ文学の新しい旗手シュウェブリンの代表作。
books.descriptionEn: Seven houses, seven stories, each a small and deeply unsettling window onto the fears that live inside ordinary homes. A mother drives through her daughter's neighborhood at night, breaking into strangers' houses to rearrange their furniture; a woman covers a neighbor's garden statues with blankets in a storm; a grandmother wanders the rooms of an empty house the family is selling. Schweblin writes with hallucinatory precision, turning the domestic and the everyday into something strange, funny, and quietly terrifying. A finalist for the International Booker Prize and a landmark of the new Latin American short story.
books.whyReadEn: Rare is the collection that polishes the eeriness of daily life to such a fine edge. Each story is a perfect, unsettling gem that lingers long after reading. Schweblin is the sharpest voice of a new generation of Latin American literature, and this book proves why.

books.title: خريطة الحب
books.author: Ahdaf Soueif
books.descriptionJa: 1900年のカイロと現代。エジプト人女性とイギリス人女性、二つの時代の愛と政治が交差する。ブッカー賞最終候補。アラブと西洋の出会いを描く、エジプト文学の傑作。
books.whyReadJa: アラブと西洋の二つの文化を、恋愛と政治で架橋する。中東を多角的に理解するための文学。
books.selectionReasonJa: ブッカー賞最終候補。エジプト現代文学を代表する傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Set in Cairo in 1900 and in the present day, this novel weaves together the lives of an Egyptian woman and an Englishwoman across two eras, where love and politics intersect. A Booker Prize finalist, it portrays the meeting of Arab and Western worlds in what is regarded as a masterpiece of Egyptian literature.
books.whyReadEn: A bridge between Arab and Western cultures, built through both romance and politics. Essential reading for understanding the Middle East from multiple perspectives.

books.title: The Impressionist
books.author: Hari Kunzru
books.descriptionJa: インドの高貴な血を引く少年プラナート。イギリス統治下のインドから、パリ、アフリカへ——アイデンティティを変転しながら生き抜く。「誰にでもなれる」ことの自由と苦しみを描く、鮮烈なデビュー作。
books.whyReadJa: 「アイデンティティ」をめぐる、ポストコロニアル文学の新しい傑作。インドと西洋の境界を描く。
books.selectionReasonJa: ポストコロニアル文学の新しい世代を代表する、ハリ・クンズルーのデビュー作。
books.descriptionEn: Pran Nath, a boy of noble Indian blood, lives through the collapse of the British Raj and transforms himself again and again — from India to Paris to Africa. This startling debut novel explores the freedom and the suffering of being able to become anyone, and the shifting nature of identity itself.
books.whyReadEn: A new postcolonial masterwork about identity, tracing the borders between India and the West.

books.title: The House on the Gulf
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.authorJa: マーガレット・アトウッド
books.descriptionJa: 未来の湾岸都市で、青い目の子どもが突然現れる。この子は何者なのか——家族の秘密と遺伝子操作をめぐる、カナダの国民的作家アトウッドの異色作。
books.whyReadJa: 遺伝子工学と家族を問う、アトウッドらしい知的な物語。『侍女の物語』の著者の多様な側面。
books.selectionReasonJa: カナダを代表する作家アトウッドの異色作。ジェンダーSFの旗手としての一面。
books.descriptionEn: In a futuristic city on the Gulf, a blue-eyed child suddenly appears. Who is this child, and where did she come from? This unusual novel by Canada's beloved author Margaret Atwood probes family secrets and the unsettling possibilities of genetic engineering.
books.whyReadEn: A typically intellectual Atwood story, questioning genetic science and family. Shows the many faces of the author of The Handmaid's Tale.
